component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Metanode to create scatter plot matrix from selected columns of input table.
Scatterplot matrix can show either standard 'y' on 'x' correlation or MA plot like correlation ('y-x' on '(x+y)/2').
Pairwise missing data imputation can be checked as well - missing value is imputed by the provided value when one of the value is missing for the given pair of column data to be correlated together. No imputation is done when both values are missing in pairwise comparison.
Note: any data preprocessing (like transformation, normalization) should be done prior the metanode usage! Note that MA plot does NOT apply additional log transformation!
